title: ICE3DP
caption: A CoreXY 3D printer that prints icing in a 150×150×50 mm cube, with sheet cooling, dual Z driven by one NEMA 17, and a NEMA 17 on the toolhead driving a lead screw to extrude the icing. Runs Klipper.
units: meters, Y-up, centered on bounding box

title: Tamagotchi
caption: A custom PCB-based Tamagotchi virtual pet built on the XIAO ESP32-C6, with a 0.96" OLED display, three buttons, and a buzzer. Case designed in Onshape, PCB in KiCad.
units: meters, Y-up, centered on bounding box
